ko.title: 35년 만의 펜실베이니아 첫 홍역 사망, 샤피로와 RFK 주니어 간의 치열한 백신 정책 충돌 촉발

segments.src: Pennsylvania has confirmed its first measles-related deaths in 35 years, a grim milestone that state officials say underscores how far childhood vaccination rates have slipped — and one that has quickly turned into a national political flashpoint.
segments.tr: 펜실베이니아주에서 35년 만에 첫 홍역 관련 사망자가 확인되었습니다. 주 정부 관료들은 이번 비극적인 이정표가 아동 예방접종률이 얼마나 떨어졌는지를 여실히 보여준다고 말하며, 이는 빠르게 국가적 정치적 쟁점으로 대두되었습니다.

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## 무슨 일이 일어났는가

segments.src: State health officials confirmed that measles was a contributing factor in the deaths of several Pennsylvania residents this year, including an infant who had not been vaccinated against the disease.
segments.tr: 주 보건 당국은 올해 펜실베이니아 주민 몇 명의 사망에 홍역이 기인한 요인이었다고 확인했으며, 여기에는 해당 질병에 대해 예방접종을 받지 않은 유아도 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Pennsylvania's last measles fatality dated back to the late 1980s, before the widespread success of the two-dose MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccination program drove the disease to the brink of elimination in the United States.
segments.tr: 펜실베이니아의 마지막 홍역 사망 기록은 1980년대 후반으로 거슬러 올라가며, 이는 2회 접종 MMR(홍역·볼거리·풍진) 예방접종 프로그램의 광범위한 성공이 미국 내 홍역을 퇴치 직전까지 몰고 가기 전의 일입니다.

segments.src: Public health experts note that measles is among the most contagious viruses known, capable of spreading through airborne droplets that can linger in a room for up to two hours after an infected person leaves.
segments.tr: 공중보건 전문가들은 홍역이 알려진 바이러스 중 가장 전염성이 강한 것 중 하나이며, 감염자가 떠난 후에도 방 안에 최대 2시간 동안 머무를 수 있는 공기 중 비말을 통해 전파될 수 있다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) says two doses of the MMR vaccine are about 97 percent effective at preventing infection, and that community, or "herd," immunity generally requires around 95 percent of a population to be vaccinated to stop sustained outbreaks.
segments.tr: 질병통제예방센터(CDC)는 MMR 백신 2회 접종이 감염 예방에 약 97퍼센트 효과가 있으며, 지역사회 또는 '집단' 면역이 지속적인 확산을 막기 위해 일반적으로 인구의 약 95퍼센트가 예방접종을 받을 것을 요구한다고 밝힙니다.

segments.src: ## A Public Disagreement Over the Cause
segments.tr: ## 원인을 둘러싼 공공의 의견 불일치

segments.src: The deaths have opened a rift between Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and U.S.
segments.tr: 이번 사망 사건으로 조쉬 샤피로 펜실베이니아 주지사와 미

segments.src: Health Secretary Robert F.
segments.tr: 보건복지부 장관 로버트 F.

segments.src: Kennedy Jr.
segments.tr: 케네디 주니어

segments.src: Shapiro's administration has pointed to declining kindergarten vaccination rates in parts of the state — a trend mirrored nationally in recent years — as a key factor behind the outbreak, and has called for renewed public messaging in support of routine childhood immunizations.
segments.tr: 사이의 균열이 생겼습니다. 샤피로 행정부는 최근 몇 년간 전국적으로 반영된 추세인 주 일부 지역의 유치원 예방접종률 감소를 이번 발병의 핵심 요인으로 지적하며, 정기 아동 예방접종을 지지하는 대국민 메시지의 갱신을 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: Kennedy, who has long expressed skepticism about vaccine safety and oversight, has publicly questioned that framing, suggesting other factors may have contributed to the deaths and calling for a broader review of the state's health data before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: 백신 안전성과 감독에 대해 오랫동안 회의적인 입장을 표명해 온 케네디는 그러한 프레임에 공개적으로 의문을 제기하며, 다른 요인들이 사망에 기여했을 수 있음을 시사하고 결론을 내리기 전에 주 보건 데이터에 대한 광범위한 검토를 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: The exchange has played out largely through public statements and social media, with each side accusing the other of politicizing a public-health tragedy.
segments.tr: 이번 공방은 주로 공개 성명과 소셜 미디어를 통해 전개되었으며, 양측은 상대방이 공중보건 비극을 정치화하고 있다고 비난했습니다.

segments.src: The disagreement reflects a wider national debate.
segments.tr: 이번 의견 불일치는 더 넓은 국가적 논쟁을 반영합니다.

segments.src: Federal health agencies under Kennedy's leadership have faced scrutiny this year over changes to vaccine advisory panels and communication about immunization schedules, even as career public-health officials and major medical associations, including the American Academy of Pediatrics, continue to recommend the standard MMR schedule for children.
segments.tr: 케네디의 리더십 아래 연방 보건 기관들은 백신 자문위원회 변경 및 예방접종 일정에 대한 소통과 관련하여 올해 심사를 받아왔으며, 경력 공중보건 관료들과 미국 소아과학회를 포함한 주요 의학 협회들은 어린이들을 위한 표준 MMR 일정을 계속해서 권장하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Part of a Bigger National Trend
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 국가적 추세의 일부

segments.src: Pennsylvania's cases follow a difficult stretch for measles control nationwide.
segments.tr: 펜실베이니아의 사례는 전국적인 홍역 통제에 있어 어려운 시기에 뒤이어 발생했습니다.

segments.src: A large outbreak centered in West Texas in 2025 sickened hundreds of people and was linked to at least two deaths among unvaccinated children, marking some of the first U.S.
segments.tr: 2025년 텍사스 서부를 중심으로 한 대규모 발병으로 수백 명이 병에 걸렸으며 예방접종을 받지 않은 어린이 중 최소 2명의 사망과 연관되어, 이는 미국 역사상 최초의 홍역 사망자 중 일부를 기록했습니다.

segments.src: measles fatalities in a decade.
segments.tr: 10년 만의 홍역 사망자입니다.

segments.src: Health officials have since tracked smaller clusters in several other states, often tied to communities with lower-than-average vaccination coverage.
segments.tr: 보건 당국은 그 이후로 평균 이하의 백신 접종률을 가진 지역사회와 종종 연관된 다른 여러 주의 소규모 집단을 추적해 왔습니다.

segments.src: The CDC has cautioned that once measles is reintroduced into an under-vaccinated community, it can spread rapidly among people who are unvaccinated or whose immunity has waned, particularly infants too young to receive their first dose, which is typically given between 12 and 15 months of age.
segments.tr: CDC는 홍역이 백신 접종률이 낮은 지역사회에 다시 유입되면 백신을 접종받지 않았거나 면역력이 떨어진 사람들 사이에서, 특히 일반적으로 생후 12개월에서 15개월 사이에 주어지는 첫 번째 접종을 받기에는 너무 어린 유아들 사이에서 빠르게 확산될 수 있다고 경고했습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 전망

segments.src: Pennsylvania's Department of Health says it is continuing to investigate the source of the outbreak and is working with local hospitals to monitor for additional cases.
segments.tr: 펜실베이니아 보건부는 이번 발병의 원인을 계속 조사하고 있으며 추가 사례를 모니터링하기 위해 지역 병원들과 협력하고 있다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Shapiro has asked state lawmakers to consider funding for expanded outreach to schools and pediatric clinics in under-vaccinated counties, while also pressing federal officials for clarity on national vaccine guidance.
segments.tr: 샤피로는 주 의원들에게 백신 접종률이 낮은 카운티의 학교와 소아과 클리닉에 대한 확대된 지원 자금을 고려해 줄 것을 요청하는 한편, 국가 백신 지침에 대한 명확성을 연방 관료들에게 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: Kennedy's office has indicated that federal health agencies will review the state's findings as part of a broader look at immunization data across the country.
segments.tr: 케네디의 사무실은 연방 보건 기관들이 전국적인 예방접종 데이터를 광범위하게 살펴보는 것의 일환으로 주의 조사 결과를 검토할 것임을 시사했습니다.

segments.src: Both sides say they support parents having access to accurate information about vaccines, even as they diverge sharply on how the current situation should be characterized.
segments.tr: 양측은 현재 상황을 어떻게 규정해야 하는지에 대해서는 극명하게 갈리지만, 부모들이 백신에 대한 정확한 정보에 접근할 수 있는 것을 지지한다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Medical groups, meanwhile, are urging families to check their children's vaccination records and consult a pediatrician or family physician with any questions about the MMR schedule, especially for infants, pregnant women, and people with weakened immune systems who face the highest risk from measles complications.
segments.tr: 한편 의료 단체들은 가족들에게 자녀의 예방접종 기록을 확인하고 MMR 일정에 관한 질문이 있을 경우 소아과 의사나 가정의학과 전문의와 상담할 것을 촉구하고 있으며, 특히 홍역 합병증의 위험이 가장 큰 유아, 임산부, 면역력이 약화된 사람들을 위해 더욱 그렇습니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and reflects publicly reported statements from state and federal officials.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로 작성되었으며 주 및 연방 관료들의 공개적으로 보도된 성명을 반영합니다.

segments.src: Readers with questions about vaccination should consult a licensed healthcare provider or their local health department.*
segments.tr: 예방접종에 관해 질문이 있는 독자는 면허를 소지한 의료 제공자 또는 지역 보건소와 상담해야 합니다.*

zh.title: 宾夕法尼亚州35年来首例麻疹死亡病例引发了夏皮罗与小肯尼迪之间激烈的疫苗政策冲突

segments.src: Pennsylvania has confirmed its first measles-related deaths in 35 years, a grim milestone that state officials say underscores how far childhood vaccination rates have slipped — and one that has quickly turned into a national political flashpoint.
segments.tr: 宾夕法尼亚州确认了该州35年来的首例麻疹相关死亡病例，这是一个严峻的里程碑，州官员称这凸显了儿童疫苗接种率下降的程度，并迅速演变成全国政治焦点。

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## 事件经过

segments.src: State health officials confirmed that measles was a contributing factor in the deaths of several Pennsylvania residents this year, including an infant who had not been vaccinated against the disease.
segments.tr: 州卫生官员确认，麻疹是今年宾夕法尼亚州几名居民死亡的诱因之一，其中包括一名未接种过该病疫苗的婴儿。

segments.src: Pennsylvania's last measles fatality dated back to the late 1980s, before the widespread success of the two-dose MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccination program drove the disease to the brink of elimination in the United States.
segments.tr: 宾夕法尼亚州上一次麻疹致死事件要追溯到20世纪80年代末，当时两剂MMR（麻疹、腮腺炎、风疹）疫苗接种计划取得了巨大成功，使该疾病在美国濒临根除。

segments.src: Public health experts note that measles is among the most contagious viruses known, capable of spreading through airborne droplets that can linger in a room for up to two hours after an infected person leaves.
segments.tr: 公共卫生专家指出，麻疹是已知传染性最强的病毒之一，能够通过空气中的飞沫传播，在感染者离开后，这些飞沫可以在房间里停留长达两个小时。

segments.src: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) says two doses of the MMR vaccine are about 97 percent effective at preventing infection, and that community, or "herd," immunity generally requires around 95 percent of a population to be vaccinated to stop sustained outbreaks.
segments.tr: 美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）表示，接种两剂MMR疫苗预防感染的有效率约为97%，而要阻止持续的疫情爆发，社区（或“群体”）免疫通常需要大约95%的人口接种疫苗。

segments.src: ## A Public Disagreement Over the Cause
segments.tr: ## 对病因的公开分歧

segments.src: The deaths have opened a rift between Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and U.S.
segments.tr: 这些死亡事件在宾夕法尼亚州长乔什·夏皮罗（Josh Shapiro）与美国

segments.src: Health Secretary Robert F.
segments.tr: 卫生部长小罗伯特·F·

segments.src: Kennedy Jr.
segments.tr: 肯尼迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）之间产生了裂痕。

segments.src: Shapiro's administration has pointed to declining kindergarten vaccination rates in parts of the state — a trend mirrored nationally in recent years — as a key factor behind the outbreak, and has called for renewed public messaging in support of routine childhood immunizations.
segments.tr: 夏皮罗政府指出，该州部分地区的幼儿园疫苗接种率不断下降——这一趋势近年来在全国范围内也有所反映——是此次疫情爆发的关键因素，并呼吁重新开展公众宣传，支持常规儿童免疫接种。

segments.src: Kennedy, who has long expressed skepticism about vaccine safety and oversight, has publicly questioned that framing, suggesting other factors may have contributed to the deaths and calling for a broader review of the state's health data before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: 长期对疫苗安全性和监管表示怀疑的肯尼迪公开质疑了这种说法，暗示其他因素可能导致了这些死亡，并呼吁在得出结论之前对该州的健康数据进行更广泛的审查。

segments.src: The exchange has played out largely through public statements and social media, with each side accusing the other of politicizing a public-health tragedy.
segments.tr: 这种交锋主要通过公开声明和社交媒体展开，双方互相指责对方将公共卫生悲剧政治化。

segments.src: The disagreement reflects a wider national debate.
segments.tr: 这一分歧反映了更广泛的国家辩论。

segments.src: Federal health agencies under Kennedy's leadership have faced scrutiny this year over changes to vaccine advisory panels and communication about immunization schedules, even as career public-health officials and major medical associations, including the American Academy of Pediatrics, continue to recommend the standard MMR schedule for children.
segments.tr: 在肯尼迪领导下的联邦卫生机构今年因疫苗咨询小组的变化以及关于免疫时间表的沟通而面临审查，尽管职业公共卫生官员和包括美国儿科学会在内的主要医疗协会继续建议儿童采用标准MMR时间表。

segments.src: ## Part of a Bigger National Trend
segments.tr: ## 更大国家趋势的一部分

segments.src: Pennsylvania's cases follow a difficult stretch for measles control nationwide.
segments.tr: 宾夕法尼亚州的病例紧随全国范围内艰难的麻疹控制期之后。

segments.src: A large outbreak centered in West Texas in 2025 sickened hundreds of people and was linked to at least two deaths among unvaccinated children, marking some of the first U.S.
segments.tr: 2025年以西德克萨斯州为中心的一次大爆发导致数百人患病，并与未接种疫苗的儿童中至少两起死亡事件有关，这标志着美国近十年来首次出现

segments.src: measles fatalities in a decade.
segments.tr: 麻疹致死事件。

segments.src: Health officials have since tracked smaller clusters in several other states, often tied to communities with lower-than-average vaccination coverage.
segments.tr: 此后，卫生官员追踪了其他几个州的较小聚集性病例，这些病例通常与疫苗接种率低于平均水平的社区有关。

segments.src: The CDC has cautioned that once measles is reintroduced into an under-vaccinated community, it can spread rapidly among people who are unvaccinated or whose immunity has waned, particularly infants too young to receive their first dose, which is typically given between 12 and 15 months of age.
segments.tr: CDC警告称，一旦麻疹重新引入疫苗接种不足的社区，它就会在未接种疫苗或免疫力减弱的人群中迅速传播，尤其是太小而无法接种第一剂的婴儿（通常在12至15个月大之间接种）。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: Pennsylvania's Department of Health says it is continuing to investigate the source of the outbreak and is working with local hospitals to monitor for additional cases.
segments.tr: 宾夕法尼亚州卫生部表示，其正在继续调查疫情来源，并正与当地医院合作监测更多病例。

segments.src: Shapiro has asked state lawmakers to consider funding for expanded outreach to schools and pediatric clinics in under-vaccinated counties, while also pressing federal officials for clarity on national vaccine guidance.
segments.tr: 夏皮罗已要求州立法者考虑为扩大对疫苗接种不足县的学校和儿科诊所的外展服务提供资金，同时敦促联邦官员明确国家疫苗指南。

segments.src: Kennedy's office has indicated that federal health agencies will review the state's findings as part of a broader look at immunization data across the country.
segments.tr: 肯尼迪办公室表示，联邦卫生机构将审查该州的调查结果，作为对全国各地免疫数据更广泛审视的一部分。

segments.src: Both sides say they support parents having access to accurate information about vaccines, even as they diverge sharply on how the current situation should be characterized.
segments.tr: 双方都表示支持父母获取有关疫苗的准确信息，尽管他们在如何描述当前形势方面存在巨大分歧。

segments.src: Medical groups, meanwhile, are urging families to check their children's vaccination records and consult a pediatrician or family physician with any questions about the MMR schedule, especially for infants, pregnant women, and people with weakened immune systems who face the highest risk from measles complications.
segments.tr: 与此同时，医疗组织敦促家庭检查孩子的疫苗接种记录，并就MMR时间表的任何问题咨询儿科医生或家庭医生，特别是对于面临麻疹并发症最高风险的婴儿、孕妇和免疫系统较弱的人群。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and reflects publicly reported statements from state and federal officials.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，反映了州和联邦官员公开报道的声明。

segments.src: Readers with questions about vaccination should consult a licensed healthcare provider or their local health department.*
segments.tr: 对疫苗接种有疑问的读者应咨询有资质的医疗保健提供者或当地卫生部门。*

hi.title: पेंसिलवेनिया में 35 वर्षों में पहली खसरे से मौत ने शापिरो और RFK जूनियर के बीच टीके की नीति को लेकर कड़े टकराव को जन्म दिया

segments.src: Pennsylvania has confirmed its first measles-related deaths in 35 years, a grim milestone that state officials say underscores how far childhood vaccination rates have slipped — and one that has quickly turned into a national political flashpoint.
segments.tr: पेंसिलवेनिया ने 35 वर्षों में अपनी पहली खसरे से संबंधित मौतों की पुष्टि की है, जो एक गंभीर मील का पत्थर है जिसके बारे में राज्य के अधिकारियों का कहना है कि यह रेखांकित करता है कि बचपन में टीकाकरण की दर कितनी गिर गई है - और एक ऐसा जो जल्दी से एक राष्ट्रीय राजनीतिक फ्लैशपॉइंट में बदल गया है。

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## क्या हुआ

segments.src: State health officials confirmed that measles was a contributing factor in the deaths of several Pennsylvania residents this year, including an infant who had not been vaccinated against the disease.
segments.tr: राज्य के स्वास्थ्य अधिकारियों ने पुष्टि की कि इस साल पेंसिलवेनिया के कई निवासियों की मौत में खसरा एक योगदान कारक था, जिसमें एक शिशु भी शामिल था जिसे इस बीमारी के खिलाफ टीका नहीं लगाया गया था।

segments.src: Pennsylvania's last measles fatality dated back to the late 1980s, before the widespread success of the two-dose MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccination program drove the disease to the brink of elimination in the United States.
segments.tr: पेंसिलवेनिया की अंतिम खसरे से मौत 1980 के दशक के उत्तरार्ध की थी, इससे पहले कि दो खुराक वाले MMR (खसरा, गलघोटू, रूबेला) टीकाकरण कार्यक्रम की व्यापक सफलता ने संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में इस बीमारी को उन्मूलन के कगार पर पहुंचा दिया था。

segments.src: Public health experts note that measles is among the most contagious viruses known, capable of spreading through airborne droplets that can linger in a room for up to two hours after an infected person leaves.
segments.tr: सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञों का कहना है कि खसरा सबसे अधिक संक्रामक वायरस में से एक है, जो हवाई बूंदों के माध्यम से फैलने में सक्षम है जो एक संक्रमित व्यक्ति के जाने के बाद दो घंटे तक कमरे में रह सकते हैं।

segments.src: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) says two doses of the MMR vaccine are about 97 percent effective at preventing infection, and that community, or "herd," immunity generally requires around 95 percent of a population to be vaccinated to stop sustained outbreaks.
segments.tr: रोग नियंत्रण और रोकथाम केंद्र (CDC) का कहना है कि MMR टीके की दो खुराकें संक्रमण को रोकने में लगभग 97 प्रतिशत प्रभावी हैं, और यह कि सामुदायिक, या "हर्ड," प्रतिरक्षा को आम तौर पर निरंतर प्रकोपों को रोकने के लिए आबादी के लगभग 95 प्रतिशत को टीका लगाने की आवश्यकता होती है。

segments.src: ## A Public Disagreement Over the Cause
segments.tr: ## कारण पर एक सार्वजनिक असहमति

segments.src: The deaths have opened a rift between Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and U.S.
segments.tr: इन मौतों ने पेंसिलवेनिया के गवर्नर जोश शापिरो और अमेरिकी

segments.src: Health Secretary Robert F.
segments.tr: स्वास्थ्य सचिव रॉबर्ट एफ.

segments.src: Kennedy Jr.
segments.tr: क्रेनेडी जूनियर

segments.src: Shapiro's administration has pointed to declining kindergarten vaccination rates in parts of the state — a trend mirrored nationally in recent years — as a key factor behind the outbreak, and has called for renewed public messaging in support of routine childhood immunizations.
segments.tr: शापिरो के प्रशासन ने राज्य के कुछ हिस्सों में किंडरगार्टन टीकाकरण दरों में गिरावट की ओर इशारा किया है - हाल के वर्षों में राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर एक प्रवृत्ति - प्रकोप के पीछे एक प्रमुख कारक के रूप में, और नियमित बचपन के टीकाकरण के समर्थन में नए सिरे से सार्वजनिक संदेश भेजने का आह्वान किया है。

segments.src: Kennedy, who has long expressed skepticism about vaccine safety and oversight, has publicly questioned that framing, suggesting other factors may have contributed to the deaths and calling for a broader review of the state's health data before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: क्रेनेडी, जिन्होंने लंबे समय से टीके की सुरक्षा और निगरानी के बारे में संदेह व्यक्त किया है, ने सार्वजनिक रूप से उस रूपरेखा पर सवाल उठाया है, यह सुझाव देते हुए कि अन्य कारकों ने मौतों में योगदान दिया हो सकता है और निष्कर्ष निकालने से पहले राज्य के स्वास्थ्य डेटा की व्यापक समीक्षा की मांग की है।

segments.src: The exchange has played out largely through public statements and social media, with each side accusing the other of politicizing a public-health tragedy.
segments.tr: यह आदान-प्रदान बड़े पैमाने पर सार्वजनिक बयानों और सोशल मीडिया के माध्यम से सामने आया है, जिसमें प्रत्येक पक्ष ने दूसरे पर सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य त्रासदी का राजनीतिकरण करने का आरोप लगाया है。

segments.src: The disagreement reflects a wider national debate.
segments.tr: यह असहमति एक व्यापक राष्ट्रीय बहस को दर्शाती है।

segments.src: Federal health agencies under Kennedy's leadership have faced scrutiny this year over changes to vaccine advisory panels and communication about immunization schedules, even as career public-health officials and major medical associations, including the American Academy of Pediatrics, continue to recommend the standard MMR schedule for children.
segments.tr: क्रेनेडी के नेतृत्व में संघीय स्वास्थ्य एजेंसियों को इस साल टीका सलाहकार पैनल में बदलाव और टीकाकरण के समय के बारे में संचार को लेकर जांच का सामना करना पड़ा है, तब भी जब करियर के सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य अधिकारी और अमेरिकन एकेडमी ऑफ पेडियाट्रिक्स सहित प्रमुख चिकित्सा संघ, बच्चों के लिए मानक MMR अनुसूची की सिफारिश करना जारी रखते हैं。

segments.src: ## Part of a Bigger National Trend
segments.tr: ## एक बड़ी राष्ट्रीय प्रवृत्ति का हिस्सा

segments.src: Pennsylvania's cases follow a difficult stretch for measles control nationwide.
segments.tr: पेंसिलवेनिया के मामले देश भर में खसरे के नियंत्रण के लिए एक कठिन दौर के बाद आते हैं।

segments.src: A large outbreak centered in West Texas in 2025 sickened hundreds of people and was linked to at least two deaths among unvaccinated children, marking some of the first U.S.
segments.tr: 2025 में पश्चिम टेक्सास में केंद्रित एक बड़े प्रकोप ने सैकड़ों लोगों को बीमार कर दिया और बिना टीका लगाए बच्चों के बीच कम से कम दो मौतों से जुड़ा था, जो कुछ पहले अमेरिकी को चिह्नित करता है।

segments.src: measles fatalities in a decade.
segments.tr: एक दशक में खसरे से मौतें।

segments.src: Health officials have since tracked smaller clusters in several other states, often tied to communities with lower-than-average vaccination coverage.
segments.tr: स्वास्थ्य अधिकारियों ने तब से कई अन्य राज्यों में छोटे समूहों को ट्रैक किया है, जो अक्सर औसत से कम टीकाकरण कवरेज वाले समुदायों से जुड़े होते हैं。

segments.src: The CDC has cautioned that once measles is reintroduced into an under-vaccinated community, it can spread rapidly among people who are unvaccinated or whose immunity has waned, particularly infants too young to receive their first dose, which is typically given between 12 and 15 months of age.
segments.tr: CDC ने चेतावनी दी है कि एक बार जब खसरे को कम-टीकाकरण वाले समुदाय में फिर से पेश किया जाता है, तो यह उन लोगों के बीच तेजी से फैल सकता है जिन्हें टीका नहीं लगाया गया है या जिनकी प्रतिरक्षा कम हो गई है, विशेष रूप से अपनी पहली खुराक प्राप्त करने के लिए बहुत छोटे शिशुओं को, जो आमतौर पर जीवन के 12 से 15 महीनों के बीच दी जाती है。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या आता है

segments.src: Pennsylvania's Department of Health says it is continuing to investigate the source of the outbreak and is working with local hospitals to monitor for additional cases.
segments.tr: पेंसिलवेनिया के स्वास्थ्य विभाग का कहना है कि वह प्रकोप के स्रोत की जांच करना जारी रख रहा है और अतिरिक्त मामलों की निगरानी के लिए स्थानीय अस्पतालों के साथ काम कर रहा है।

segments.src: Shapiro has asked state lawmakers to consider funding for expanded outreach to schools and pediatric clinics in under-vaccinated counties, while also pressing federal officials for clarity on national vaccine guidance.
segments.tr: शापिरो ने राज्य के कानून निर्माताओं से कम-टीकाकरण वाले काउंटियों में स्कूलों और बाल चिकित्सा क्लीनिकों तक विस्तारित पहुंच के लिए फंडिंग पर विचार करने के लिए कहा है, जबकि राष्ट्रीय टीका मार्गदर्शन पर स्पष्टता के लिए संघीय अधिकारियों पर दबाव भी डाला है。

segments.src: Kennedy's office has indicated that federal health agencies will review the state's findings as part of a broader look at immunization data across the country.
segments.tr: क्रेनेडी के कार्यालय ने संकेत दिया है कि संघीय स्वास्थ्य एजेंसियां देश भर में टीकाकरण डेटा पर एक व्यापक नज़र के हिस्से के रूप में राज्य के निष्कर्षों की समीक्षा करेंगी।

segments.src: Both sides say they support parents having access to accurate information about vaccines, even as they diverge sharply on how the current situation should be characterized.
segments.tr: दोनों पक्षों का कहना है कि वे माता-पिता को टीकों के बारे में सटीक जानकारी तक पहुँच का समर्थन करते हैं, तब भी जब वे इस बात पर गहराई से भिन्न होते हैं कि वर्तमान स्थिति की विशेषता कैसे होनी चाहिए。

segments.src: Medical groups, meanwhile, are urging families to check their children's vaccination records and consult a pediatrician or family physician with any questions about the MMR schedule, especially for infants, pregnant women, and people with weakened immune systems who face the highest risk from measles complications.
segments.tr: इस बीच, चिकित्सा समूह परिवारों से आग्रह कर रहे हैं कि वे अपने बच्चों के टीकाकरण रिकॉर्ड की जांच करें और MMR अनुसूची के बारे में किसी भी प्रश्न के साथ बाल रोग विशेषज्ञ या परिवार के चिकित्सक से परामर्श करें, विशेष रूप से शिशुओं, गर्भवती महिलाओं और कमजोर प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली वाले लोगों के लिए जो खसरे की जटिलताओं से सबसे अधिक जोखिम का सामना करते हैं。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and reflects publicly reported statements from state and federal officials.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य जानकारी के उद्देश्य से है और राज्य और संघीय अधिकारियों के सार्वजनिक रूप से रिपोर्ट किए गए बयानों को दर्शाता है।

segments.src: Readers with questions about vaccination should consult a licensed healthcare provider or their local health department.*
segments.tr: टीकाकरण के बारे में प्रश्न वाले पाठकों को एक लाइसेंस प्राप्त स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदाता या उनके स्थानीय स्वास्थ्य विभाग से परामर्श करना चाहिए।*

es.title: Las primeras muertes por sarampión en Pensilvania en 35 años provocan un amargo enfrentamiento sobre la política de vacunación entre Shapiro y RFK Jr.

segments.src: Pennsylvania has confirmed its first measles-related deaths in 35 years, a grim milestone that state officials say underscores how far childhood vaccination rates have slipped — and one that has quickly turned into a national political flashpoint.
segments.tr: Pensilvania ha confirmado sus primeras muertes relacionadas con el sarampión en 35 años, un sombrío hito que, según los funcionarios estatales, subraya cuánto han disminuido las tasas de vacunación infantil, y que rápidamente se ha convertido en un punto de conflicto político nacional.

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## Qué sucedió

segments.src: State health officials confirmed that measles was a contributing factor in the deaths of several Pennsylvania residents this year, including an infant who had not been vaccinated against the disease.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de salud estatales confirmaron que el sarampión fue un factor contribuyente en las muertes de varios residentes de Pensilvania este año, incluido un bebé que no había sido vacunado contra la enfermedad.

segments.src: Pennsylvania's last measles fatality dated back to the late 1980s, before the widespread success of the two-dose MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccination program drove the disease to the brink of elimination in the United States.
segments.tr: La última muerte por sarampión en Pensilvania se remonta a finales de la década de 1980, antes de que el éxito generalizado del programa de vacunación de dos dosis contra el sarampión, las paperas y la rubéola (triple vírica o MMR) llevara a la enfermedad al borde de la eliminación en los Estados Unidos.

segments.src: Public health experts note that measles is among the most contagious viruses known, capable of spreading through airborne droplets that can linger in a room for up to two hours after an infected person leaves.
segments.tr: Los expertos en salud pública señalan que el sarampión es uno de los virus más contagiosos que se conocen, capaz de propagarse a través de gotículas en el aire que pueden permanecer en una habitación hasta dos horas después de que una persona infectada se haya ido.

segments.src: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) says two doses of the MMR vaccine are about 97 percent effective at preventing infection, and that community, or "herd," immunity generally requires around 95 percent of a population to be vaccinated to stop sustained outbreaks.
segments.tr: Los Centros para el Control y la Prevención de Enfermedades (CDC) afirman que dos dosis de la vacuna MMR tienen una eficacia de aproximadamente el 97 por ciento para prevenir la infección, y que la inmunidad comunitaria, o "de rebaño", generalmente requiere que alrededor del 95 por ciento de la población esté vacunada para detener los brotes sostenidos.

segments.src: ## A Public Disagreement Over the Cause
segments.tr: ## Un desacuerdo público sobre la causa

segments.src: The deaths have opened a rift between Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and U.S.
segments.tr: Las muertes han abierto una brecha entre el gobernador de Pensilvania, Josh Shapiro, y el secretario de Salud de EE.

segments.src: Health Secretary Robert F.
segments.tr: UU., Robert F.

segments.src: Kennedy Jr.
segments.tr: Kennedy Jr.

segments.src: Shapiro's administration has pointed to declining kindergarten vaccination rates in parts of the state — a trend mirrored nationally in recent years — as a key factor behind the outbreak, and has called for renewed public messaging in support of routine childhood immunizations.
segments.tr: La administración de Shapiro ha señalado la disminución de las tasas de vacunación en el jardín de infancia en partes del estado —una tendencia reflejada a nivel nacional en los últimos años— como un factor clave detrás del brote, y ha pedido un renovado mensaje público en apoyo de las inmunizaciones infantiles rutinarias.

segments.src: Kennedy, who has long expressed skepticism about vaccine safety and oversight, has publicly questioned that framing, suggesting other factors may have contributed to the deaths and calling for a broader review of the state's health data before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: Kennedy, quien ha expresado durante mucho tiempo escepticismo sobre la seguridad y la supervisión de las vacunas, ha cuestionado públicamente ese enfoque, sugiriendo que otros factores pueden haber contribuido a las muertes y pidiendo una revisión más amplia de los datos de salud del estado antes de sacar conclusiones.

segments.src: The exchange has played out largely through public statements and social media, with each side accusing the other of politicizing a public-health tragedy.
segments.tr: El intercambio se ha desarrollado en gran medida a través de declaraciones públicas y redes sociales, con cada bando acusando al otro de politizar una tragedia de salud pública.

segments.src: The disagreement reflects a wider national debate.
segments.tr: El desacuerdo refleja un debate nacional más amplio.

segments.src: Federal health agencies under Kennedy's leadership have faced scrutiny this year over changes to vaccine advisory panels and communication about immunization schedules, even as career public-health officials and major medical associations, including the American Academy of Pediatrics, continue to recommend the standard MMR schedule for children.
segments.tr: Las agencias federales de salud bajo el liderazgo de Kennedy han enfrentado escrutinio este año por cambios en los paneles asesores de vacunas y la comunicación sobre los calendarios de inmunización, incluso cuando los funcionarios de salud pública de carrera y las principales asociaciones médicas, incluida la Academia Estadounidense de Pediatría, continúan recomendando el calendario estándar de MMR para los niños.

segments.tr: ## Parte de una tendencia nacional mayor

segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi

segments.src: State health officials confirmed that measles was a contributing factor in the deaths of several Pennsylvania residents this year, including an infant who had not been vaccinated against the disease.
segments.tr: Para pejabat kesehatan negara bagian mengonfirmasi bahwa campak merupakan faktor penentu dalam kematian beberapa penduduk Pennsylvania tahun ini, termasuk seorang bayi yang belum divaksinasi terhadap penyakit tersebut.

segments.src: Pennsylvania's last measles fatality dated back to the late 1980s, before the widespread success of the two-dose MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccination program drove the disease to the brink of elimination in the United States.
segments.tr: Kematian akibat campak terakhir di Pennsylvania terjadi pada akhir tahun 1980-an, sebelum keberhasilan luas dari program vaksinasi dua dosis MMR (measles, mumps, rubella / campak, gondongan, rubella) mendorong penyakit tersebut ke ambang eliminasi di Amerika Serikat.

segments.src: Public health experts note that measles is among the most contagious viruses known, capable of spreading through airborne droplets that can linger in a room for up to two hours after an infected person leaves.
segments.tr: Para ahli kesehatan masyarakat mencatat bahwa campak adalah salah satu virus paling menular yang diketahui, mampu menyebar melalui droplet udara yang dapat bertahan di dalam ruangan hingga dua jam setelah orang yang terinfeksi pergi.

segments.src: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) says two doses of the MMR vaccine are about 97 percent effective at preventing infection, and that community, or "herd," immunity generally requires around 95 percent of a population to be vaccinated to stop sustained outbreaks.
segments.tr: Pusat Pengendalian dan Pencegahan Penyakit (CDC) menyatakan bahwa dua dosis vaksin MMR memiliki efektivitas sekitar 97 persen dalam mencegah infeksi, dan bahwa kekebalan komunitas, atau "kelompok", umumnya membutuhkan sekitar 95 persen dari populasi untuk divaksinasi guna menghentikan wabah yang berkelanjutan.

de.title: Pennsylvanias erste Masern-Todesfälle seit 35 Jahren lösen heftigen Streit über Impfpolitik zwischen Shapiro und RFK Jr. aus

segments.src: Pennsylvania has confirmed its first measles-related deaths in 35 years, a grim milestone that state officials say underscores how far childhood vaccination rates have slipped — and one that has quickly turned into a national political flashpoint.
segments.tr: Pennsylvania hat seine ersten Masern-Todesfälle seit 35 Jahren bestätigt, ein düsterer Meilenstein, der laut Staatsbeamten unterstreicht, wie stark die Impfraten bei Kindern gesunken sind – und der sich schnell zu einem nationalen politischen Brennpunkt entwickelt hat.

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## Was ist passiert

segments.src: State health officials confirmed that measles was a contributing factor in the deaths of several Pennsylvania residents this year, including an infant who had not been vaccinated against the disease.
segments.tr: Gesundheitsbehörden des Bundesstaates bestätigten, dass Masern ein beitragender Faktor bei den Todesfällen mehrerer Einwohner Pennsylvanias in diesem Jahr waren, darunter ein Säugling, der nicht gegen die Krankheit geimpft worden war.

segments.src: Pennsylvania's last measles fatality dated back to the late 1980s, before the widespread success of the two-dose MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccination program drove the disease to the brink of elimination in the United States.
segments.tr: Der letzte Masern-Todesfall in Pennsylvania lag in den späten 1980er Jahren, bevor der weit verbreitete Erfolg des zweifachen MMR-Impfprogramms (Masern, Mumps, Röteln) die Krankheit in den Vereinigten Staaten an den Rand der Ausrottung brachte.

segments.src: Public health experts note that measles is among the most contagious viruses known, capable of spreading through airborne droplets that can linger in a room for up to two hours after an infected person leaves.
segments.tr: Experten für öffentliche Gesundheit weisen darauf hin, dass Masern zu den ansteckendsten bekannten Viren gehören und sich über Tröpfchen in der Luft verbreiten können, die bis zu zwei Stunden in einem Raum verweilen können, nachdem eine infizierte Person ihn verlassen hat.

segments.src: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) says two doses of the MMR vaccine are about 97 percent effective at preventing infection, and that community, or "herd," immunity generally requires around 95 percent of a population to be vaccinated to stop sustained outbreaks.
segments.tr: Die Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) geben an, dass zwei Dosen des MMR-Impfstoffs zu etwa 97 Prozent wirksam bei der Vorbeugung einer Infektion sind und dass die Gemeinschafts- oder „Herdenimmunität“ im Allgemeinen erfordert, dass etwa 95 Prozent der Bevölkerung geimpft sind, um anhaltende Ausbrüche zu stoppen.

segments.src: ## A Public Disagreement Over the Cause
segments.tr: ## Ein öffentlicher Streit über die Ursache

segments.src: The deaths have opened a rift between Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and U.S.
segments.tr: Die Todesfälle haben einen Riss zwischen dem Gouverneur von Pennsylvania, Josh Shapiro, und dem US-Gesundheitsminister Robert F.

segments.src: Health Secretary Robert F.
segments.tr: Gesundheitsminister Robert F.

segments.src: Kennedy Jr.
segments.tr: Kennedy Jr.

segments.src: Shapiro's administration has pointed to declining kindergarten vaccination rates in parts of the state — a trend mirrored nationally in recent years — as a key factor behind the outbreak, and has called for renewed public messaging in support of routine childhood immunizations.
segments.tr: Shapiros Regierung hat auf die sinkenden Impfraten bei Kindergartenkindern in Teilen des Bundesstaates hingewiesen – ein Trend, der sich in den letzten Jahren landesweit widerspiegelt – als Schlüsselfaktor für den Ausbruch und hat zu einer erneuerten öffentlichen Kommunikation zur Unterstützung routinemäßiger Kinderimpfungen aufgerufen.

segments.src: Kennedy, who has long expressed skepticism about vaccine safety and oversight, has publicly questioned that framing, suggesting other factors may have contributed to the deaths and calling for a broader review of the state's health data before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: Kennedy, der schon lange Skepsis gegenüber der Sicherheit und Überwachung von Impfstoffen geäußert hat, hat diese Darstellung öffentlich in Frage gestellt, angedeutet, dass andere Faktoren zu den Todesfällen beigetragen haben könnten, und eine umfassendere Überprüfung der Gesundheitsdaten des Bundesstaates gefordert, bevor Schlussfolgerungen gezogen werden.

segments.src: The exchange has played out largely through public statements and social media, with each side accusing the other of politicizing a public-health tragedy.
segments.tr: Der Austausch fand größtenteils durch öffentliche Erklärungen und soziale Medien statt, wobei sich beide Seiten gegenseitig beschuldigten, eine Tragödie der öffentlichen Gesundheit zu politisieren.

segments.src: The disagreement reflects a wider national debate.
segments.tr: Die Meinungsverschiedenheit spiegelt eine breitere nationale Debatte wider.

segments.src: Federal health agencies under Kennedy's leadership have faced scrutiny this year over changes to vaccine advisory panels and communication about immunization schedules, even as career public-health officials and major medical associations, including the American Academy of Pediatrics, continue to recommend the standard MMR schedule for children.
segments.tr: Bundesgesundheitsbehörden unter Kennedys Führung sahen sich dieses Jahr mit Kritik an Änderungen bei Impfberatungsgremien und der Kommunikation über Impfpläne konfrontiert, obwohl Karrierebeamte des öffentlichen Gesundheitswesens und große medizinische Verbände, einschließlich der American Academy of Pediatrics, weiterhin den Standard-MMR-Plan für Kinder empfehlen.

segments.src: ## Part of a Bigger National Trend
segments.tr: ## Teil eines größeren nationalen Trends

segments.src: Pennsylvania's cases follow a difficult stretch for measles control nationwide.
segments.tr: Die Fälle in Pennsylvania folgen auf eine schwierige Phase für die Masernkontrolle im ganzen Land.

segments.src: A large outbreak centered in West Texas in 2025 sickened hundreds of people and was linked to at least two deaths among unvaccinated children, marking some of the first U.S.
segments.tr: Ein großer Ausbruch im Zentrum von West Texas im Jahr 2025 machte Hunderte von Menschen krank und wurde mit mindestens zwei Todesfällen bei ungeimpften Kindern in Verbindung gebracht, was einige der ersten US-Masern-Todesfälle seit einem Jahrzehnt markierte.

segments.tr: Masern-Todesfälle seit einem Jahrzehnt.

segments.src: Health officials have since tracked smaller clusters in several other states, often tied to communities with lower-than-average vaccination coverage.
segments.tr: Gesundheitsbehörden haben seitdem kleinere Cluster in mehreren anderen Bundesstaaten verfolgt, die oft mit Gemeinschaften mit unterdurchschnittlicher Impfabdeckung in Verbindung stehen.

segments.src: The CDC has cautioned that once measles is reintroduced into an under-vaccinated community, it can spread rapidly among people who are unvaccinated or whose immunity has waned, particularly infants too young to receive their first dose, which is typically given between 12 and 15 months of age.
segments.tr: Die CDC hat davor gewarnt, dass Masern, sobald sie wieder in eine untergeimpfte Gemeinschaft eingeführt werden, sich schnell unter Menschen ausbreiten können, die ungeimpft sind oder deren Immunität nachgelassen hat, insbesondere bei Säuglingen, die zu jung sind, um ihre erste Dosis zu erhalten, die normalerweise im Alter zwischen 12 und 15 Monaten verabreicht wird.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Wie es weitergeht

segments.src: Pennsylvania's Department of Health says it is continuing to investigate the source of the outbreak and is working with local hospitals to monitor for additional cases.
segments.tr: Das Gesundheitsministerium von Pennsylvania gibt an, dass es weiterhin die Quelle des Ausbruchs untersucht und mit örtlichen Krankenhäusern zusammenarbeitet, um auf weitere Fälle zu achten.

segments.src: Shapiro has asked state lawmakers to consider funding for expanded outreach to schools and pediatric clinics in under-vaccinated counties, while also pressing federal officials for clarity on national vaccine guidance.
segments.tr: Shapiro hat die Gesetzgeber des Bundesstaates gebeten, eine Finanzierung für eine verstärkte Öffentlichkeitsarbeit an Schulen und Kinderkliniken in untergeimpften Bezirken in Betracht zu ziehen, während er gleichzeitig Bundesbeamte um Klarheit bei den nationalen Impfrichtlinien drängt.

segments.src: Kennedy's office has indicated that federal health agencies will review the state's findings as part of a broader look at immunization data across the country.
segments.tr: Kennedys Büro hat angedeutet, dass die Bundesgesundheitsbehörden die Ergebnisse des Bundesstaates als Teil einer umfassenderen Betrachtung der Impfdaten im ganzen Land überprüfen werden.

segments.src: Both sides say they support parents having access to accurate information about vaccines, even as they diverge sharply on how the current situation should be characterized.
segments.tr: Beide Seiten sagen, dass sie unterstützen, dass Eltern Zugang zu genauen Informationen über Impfstoffe haben, auch wenn sie sich stark darin unterscheiden, wie die aktuelle Situation charakterisiert werden sollte.

segments.src: Medical groups, meanwhile, are urging families to check their children's vaccination records and consult a pediatrician or family physician with any questions about the MMR schedule, especially for infants, pregnant women, and people with weakened immune systems who face the highest risk from measles complications.
segments.tr: Medizinische Gruppen fordern unterdessen Familien auf, die Impfausweise ihrer Kinder zu überprüfen und bei Fragen zum MMR-Plan einen Kinderarzt oder Hausarzt zu konsultieren, insbesondere für Säuglinge, schwangere Frauen und Menschen mit geschwächtem Immunsystem, die das höchste Risiko für Masernkomplikationen tragen.

segments.tr: Leser mit Fragen zur Impfung sollten einen zugelassenen Gesundheitsdienstleister oder ihr örtliches Gesundheitsamt konsultieren.*
